spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact surfaces both authorities name: navigator.rtc + its three methods (Chromium navigator_rtc.idl/rtc.idl, the shape the Chrome 151 origin trial actually ships) and the current WICG draft's three RTCPeerConnection statics — a dual-surface probe the v150 predecessor lacked, added because the draft moved the IDL location after v150 was built; the gate steps state secure context, the exact flag, the OT trial name, and the enterprise policy.

interactive.rationale: Re-run probe button re-evaluates every surface live into two semantic tables with yes/no pills and a status line that names which binding (if any) is complete; each probe checks the exact member and can return false — verified returning all-no honestly in the harness browser.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index card promises dual-shape detection plus the full enablement gate, which is exactly what the page renders.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes binding-absent vs binding-present-but-method-missing, non-secure-context, and the policy layer that gates real collection even when methods exist — including the by-design impossibility of observing collection from the page.

references.rationale: Gate step 2 and see-also link chromestatus.com/feature/5091582546149376 directly; the OT registration console and the enterprise-policy reference are linked from the gate and the feature index.

conformance.rationale: The suite mirrors this page's contracts: per-static typeof checks, the any-known-binding assertion, and the [SecureContext] gate that passes exactly when the probe's secure/absent logic holds; watched executing live on the conformance route.

runtime_evidence.rationale: This page's whole contract — honest detection — was fully exercisable in the harness: CDP run on headless Chromium 141 shows all seven pills 'no', warn status naming the missing prerequisite (flag/OT, not browser age alone), secure-context ✓, re-run works, zero console errors; desktop and 360px screenshots read (tables wrap cleanly). The all-yes branch requires a bound browser and remains untested here, as recorded in the open question.

telemetry_health.rationale: rtc-probe-consistent (fails if a binding root exists without callable methods — a real can-fail invariant) and rtc-probe-ran with both binding verdicts and secure-context state; both observed emitting without network failures.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; yes/no pills set background+color pairs (emerald/rose with bg-ivory text); table headers invert both; gate steps alternate bg-ivory/bg-paper.

accessibility.rationale: Both probe tables use caption + th scope=col so the two bindings are announced distinctly; status line is role=status aria-live; the re-run control is a native button; pill verdicts are text ('yes'/'no'), not colour-only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness desktop OK / mobile OK; this concept measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3, zero console errors, and the 360px screenshot was read: long method names wrap inside cells (overflow-wrap:anywhere), captions and pills legible.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the all-yes and mixed probe branches on a bound browser
openQuestions.detail: In the unbound harness only the all-no branch could run. On Chrome 151+ with --enable-blink-features=RTCDiagnosticLogging, confirm the navigator.rtc table flips to yes with the status naming the OT shape, and check whether any Chromium build ever exposes the RTCPeerConnection statics (if Chromium adopts the new spec IDL, the second table's copy about 'Chrome 151 ships navigator.rtc' may need a milestone-qualified update).

openQuestions.title: Watch the origin-trial window on chromestatus for extension or early ship
openQuestions.detail: Copy states OT desktop 151–156 and ship estimate 156 per the chromestatus API updated 2026-08-12 (origin_trial_id 352969620795162625 now public — this resolved the v150 critique's open question about missing registration). If the trial is extended or the feature ships, update gate step 2 and the feature index enabling-it section.

guidanceConsulted.query: semantic data tables with captions for probe results and colour-independent status
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use caption and th scope for data tables and never rely on colour alone to convey state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: both binding tables gained caption elements naming the binding; verdicts are literal yes/no text inside the coloured pills; status line is a text live region.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP run 2026-08-16: table captions and pill text present in DOM; screenshots read

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table no horizontal overflow narrow mobile viewport
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Allow long unbreakable tokens to wrap inside table cells instead of widening the table.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: overflow-wrap:anywhere on td (the fix class the v150 family needed retrofitted is built-in here); measured 0px overflow at 360×740 with two stacked tables.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: mobile-check CDP run 2026-08-16: scrollWidth − innerWidth = 0 at 360px

summary: v151 adaptation upgraded to a dual-surface probe: the v150 page only knew navigator.rtc, but the WICG draft moved the API to RTCPeerConnection statics after v150 shipped, so this page probes and explains both shapes and reports which is live. Gate copy re-provenanced to the 2026-08-12 chromestatus data (OT 151–156, public registration — resolving v150's open question) with the exact trial name. Fully runtime-verified in its honest all-no branch; bound branches are open questions.
